name: Swirlby · Gremlet #10
description:
A snail with a perfectly round swirl shell. It's never late, just taking the scenic route.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Swirlby in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
